tools.name: search_cars
tools.description: Search new and used cars for sale at the franchise dealerships in Glendale, California (Brand Boulevard). Returns cars with price, mileage, dealer and a link. Prices are set by the dealer and exclude tax and fees.

tools.name: get_car
tools.description: Full details for one car by its id (from search_cars), including photos, dealer contact and whether it has sold.

tools.name: list_dealerships
tools.description: Every franchise car dealership in Glendale, CA listed on CarGlendale, with brand, address, phone and how many cars each has listed.

tools.name: out_the_door_price
tools.description: Estimate what a car really costs in Glendale, CA: price plus 11% sales tax, the dealer document fee and California DMV fees, line by line.
